channel.title: News Board
channel.description: A personal daily news briefing: AI labs, tech, finance and Fornebu.
channel.itunes:author: News Board

item.title: Friday 13 November
item.description: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO, Colette Kress named interim · Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen, replacing its 3.8 Flash model · Microsoft still fighting to fix global Outlook and Teams outage · UK economy grows at fastest rate in more than two years · Oslo to close most of the metro for four days over Fornebubanen signal system

item.title: Thursday 12 November
item.description: Nvidia board reportedly nears decision to fire CEO Jensen Huang · Norges Bank's new report flags continued risk to financial stability · TSMC to invest $1 billion in Anthropic and OpenAI · Google DeepMind unveils AlphaGenome 2 for reading disease-linked DNA · AI data centres plan huge on-site gas plants to dodge grid delays

item.title: Wednesday 11 November
item.description: Anthropic launches IPO roadshow, now targets up to $1.4tn, below $2tn hoped · Oslo confirms Fornebubanen a year late after contractor talks collapse · US consumer prices rose 0.4% in October, a touch above forecasts · Norway's consumer prices rose 3.6% in October, pushed up by power costs · Google opens Gemini 4 Carbon to all developers, weeks after limited access

item.title: Tuesday 10 November
item.description: Fornebubanen heads for a new overrun of up to 4 billion kroner · Anthropic launches Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 · Trump says FBI is investigating Nvidia boss's affair with alleged Chinese spy · Oil price falls more than $6 a barrel overnight · Google unveils new TPUs built for the agentic era

item.title: Monday 9 November
item.description: Nvidia's board opens formal probe into Huang's ties to suspected Chinese spy · Statnett: 2026 power-grid requests already exceed Norway's record peak demand · Elvis and Eminem rights-holders sue Suno over AI voice and lyric mimicry · Jaguar Land Rover has BYD's Dutch offices raided over 'copycat car' claim · Lysaker could get high-rises under newly announced area changes

item.title: Sunday 8 November
item.description: Outside report finds Anthropic speeding up AI research almost twofold · Berkshire Hathaway profit falls 28% as Abel ramps up buybacks · A Chinese firm cleared for Nvidia's H200 chips has an empty office · Claude Code's 'Don't Ask Again' setting leaked secrets on GitHub · OpenAI pledges to cover power costs at its own data centres

item.title: Saturday 7 November
item.description: Global stocks tumble on AI-regulation fears after US midterms, then pare losses · OpenAI's new funding round values it at $1.25 trillion · Tesla winds down Cybertruck production, Musk shifts to Cybercab · US employers added 165,000 jobs in October, well above forecasts · China reportedly recruited an AI executive to spy on Nvidia's Jensen Huang

item.title: Friday 6 November
item.description: Nasdaq has worst day in 18 months on AI-regulation fears · Bank of England raises rates to 4%, first rise in three years · Norges Bank holds the policy rate at 4.5% · OpenAI drops NDAs for data-centre communities amid EU protests · Anthropic launches Claude Personal Finance, linked to your bank via Plaid

item.title: Thursday 5 November
item.description: OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer Company to expand Codex · Anthropic publishes research on provable inference for AI models · Bank of England expected to raise rates to 4%, first rise in 3 years · AMD posts record $13.4bn quarter as data-center revenue nearly doubles · Fornebubanen hired consultants to review their own earlier work

item.title: Wednesday 4 November
item.description: Cyberattacks spike freezer temperatures across the UK and in Norway · US tech stocks recover after selloff over AI spending fears · Hidden AI debt at US tech giants swells 90% to $3.2tn in six months · AMD posts record quarterly revenue as AI chip demand surges · OpenAI says ChatGPT's search volume has reached a fifth of Google's

item.title: Tuesday 3 November
item.description: Anthropic publicly files for a Nasdaq IPO, after a confidential filing in June · Apple beats forecasts in CEO John Ternus's first earnings report · UK and EU agree draft deal to scrap Brexit red tape on food exports · New York Times sues Brave browser over AI scraping and paywall bypass · Oil price falls over 6% to a two-week low on hopes of an Iran war breakthrough

item.title: Monday 2 November
item.description: Binance covers 90% of losses as investors pull $3.6bn from hacked exchange · Thousands of jobs at Virgin Media O2 to be cut · AI bubble fears deepen as little-known lenders carry datacentre debt · National Grid to build UK's biggest substation for an AI datacentre · Oslo review finds Fornebubanen mis-organised, hit by conflicted consultants

item.title: Sunday 1 November
item.description: German cost-of-living protests turn violent, shops looted in four cities · Flaw let hackers take over ChatGPT accounts, now fixed by OpenAI · Tech billionaires spend $368m fighting California wealth-tax vote · Telenor warns on Starlink risk as SpaceX seeks meeting with Norway · OpenAI to honor website opt-outs from AI training via robots.txt

item.title: Saturday 31 October
item.description: Anthropic's Claude Code extension was backdoored on Cursor for 12 hours · North Korea blamed for Binance's record $6.3bn crypto heist · US tech stocks hit a two-month low as AI spending nears $1tn · OpenAI, Google, Microsoft and Anthropic back new AI scraping opt-out tool · Google's Suncatcher satellite sends back its first AI response from orbit
